Rust web framework comparison

Community-maintained comparison table of Rust web frameworks including Axum, Actix Web, Rocket, and Warp, with links to benchmarks and examples.

Actix Web: fast and reliable web framework

The fastest Rust web framework in existence. Focus on performance, reliability, and ease of use with a modular design.

Axum - ergonomic and modular web framework

Build reliable and maintainable services with confidence. Axum is a web framework for Rust that focuses on ergonomics and modularity.
